patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I get this sharp stab when I breathe in and I'm weirdly short of breath. My right calf's been sore and swollen for a few days. I'm on the pill and I just got back from a long flight.
clinical.presentationShort: 28yo F on OCPs, recent long-haul flight — pleuritic chest pain, dyspnea, tachycardia, unilateral swollen tender calf — PE with DVT.
clinical.presentationLong: 28-year-old female on oral contraceptives after a long-haul flight, with pleuritic chest pain, dyspnea, tachycardia, and a swollen tender calf — pulmonary embolism with DVT.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → CT pulmonary angiogram, anticoagulation, risk-stratify; the swollen calf is the clue.
diagnosis.why: Young and 'just anxious'? Check the calf and the risk factors. PE is a top missed killer — the swollen calf gives it away.
diagnosis.redFlag: Pleuritic pain + dyspnea + unilateral calf swelling + estrogen/immobility = PE.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting upright, one hand on her chest, breathing shallowly
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 28-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting upright, one hand pressed to her chest, breathing shallowly, one lower leg extended showing a swollen calf. Expression: anxious and short of breath. Clearly visible: a hand on the chest and one visibly swollen calf. No text, no logos.
